## Checklist

- [ ] The description explains the user impact and implementation.
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes.
- [ ] `pnpm lint` passes with no new warnings.
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes, with tests added or updated where behavior changed.
- [ ] `pnpm build` passes.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where needed.
- [ ] No secrets, real legal documents, or personal data are included.
- [ ] UI changes include screenshots or a short recording.

## Privacy and security notes

Explain any changes to data storage, provider calls, permissions, authentication, or logging.
